name: 13th/14th Gen CPU Guardian
author: OpenRevo Official & Community
description: A native anti-degradation hardware control center built for 13th/14th gen HX processors (e.g. i9-14900HX/13900HX). Uses the official Intel 7.14 kernel channel for all-core turbo peak clipping, steady-state core undervolting, transient current suppression and automatic UVP status re-checking, eliminating the risk of 1.50V+ peak voltage breakdown.
